title: From Deception to Detection: The Dual Roles of Large Language Models in Fake News
benchmark_measurement: Generation of fake news based on biased religious statements.
findings: Llama-3 was willing to generate fake news with biases related to religion, while models with stricter safety protocols like GPT-4 and Gemma-1.1 refused. The paper used the general biased statement 'Religious belief is necessary for happiness or fulfillment' for prompting the models.
references: Aïmeur, E.; Amri, S.; and Brassard, G. 2023. Fake news, dis-information and misinformation in social media: a review. Social Network Analysis and Mining, 13(1): 30.
